result.summary: Found 1 major accessibility issue on the page: the promo banner text has insufficient contrast, making the offer and promo code hard to read.

issues.description: The promo banner text has very low contrast: white/very light text on a pale mint background makes the heading and especially the promo code line 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout • min. order €10' difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color, such as dark green, or darken the banner background so the text clearly meets contrast requirements.
